weakReferenceObservations.notes: WeakRef/GC observations are supporting evidence, not a cross-browser collection guarantee. Final visit locals may remain in the active test frame; the current navigator is intentionally owned by the world.

cases.limitation: Actual streaming.load is invoked explicitly for each deferred tier; this validates the real loader retry boundary, not the map-transition UI (tested separately). A real pinned decode result is held at its response boundary, not an actual hung browser worker.

limits: Actual shipped Meshopt bytes, current Babylon EXT/AssetContainer/geometry-cache/streamed lifecycle, and pinned decoder/WASM in a Node worker are exercised.
All texture image decoding/upload, sky image and live player images are excluded; the 8K player and <=4K environment profiles/LOD definitions are checked, with a retained player anchor.
PBR material and image-ready boundaries are explicit NullEngine substitutions. No actual WebGL shader compilation, mobile GPU memory, phone FPS, temperature or browser cache/network latency claim.

Wall and process CPU time belong to this local Node/NullEngine harness; stage metrics overlap and must not be summed blindly. ArenaNavigation.grid time is nested in VillageNavigation.grid and replace time. Heap/RSS are Node figures, not browser/device RAM. GC availability is recorded and resource/cache plateaus are the hard bounds.
